_comment: Per-entity literature volume and depth budget. Written by the triage stage, consumed by the research stage to decide how many passes an entity gets. Counts are estimates for budgeting only and are never a source for a claim's n_studies or n_participants. Entries for dropped entities are kept: they are the record that the drop was confirmed rather than inferred. Write through tools/triage.py, not by hand. See ../SCHEMA.md, section Triage.

triage.triage_notes: Searched under Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG, Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG, LGG, Culturelle, Enflora LGG, and ATCC 53103. This is the most-studied probiotic strain in the literature: dozens of SRs/meta-analyses and on the order of 200 human trials. Criterion 2 (consumer-available): confirmed, Culturelle is a major US/CA/UK retail product, also AEProbio-listed. Criterion 3 (evidenced): overwhelmingly confirmed with human-trial SRs in GI (AAD prevention, acute gastroenteritis treatment, functional abdominal pain/IBS, infant colic), Immune (URTI/otitis media incidence, antibiotic use), Metabolic (glycemic/HbA1c and lipid RCTs, mixed results), and Mental health (small RCTs on cognition/stress, mostly null to modest); plus published bacteremia/meningitis case reports in immunocompromised and central-line patients (Safety). Criterion 4 (distinct): confirmed against the other three rhamnosus entities already on the roster (HN001, GR-1, R0011) and the four rhamnosus entries in excluded_entities (LcR35, IDCC 3201, two BV products) - none share this strain designation. Preparation: live, matching every trial found; no live/heat-inactivated split like the CP2305 case. TAXONOMY TRAP for research passes: several other L. rhamnosus strains are heavily studied and must not be conflated with GG - HN001 (gestational diabetes, glycemic RCTs), CNCM I-3690 (academic-stress RCT), and JB-1 (rodent-only vagal/GABA mechanistic work); check strain identifiers in each paper, not just the species name. SCOPE NOTE: a large share of known_for (atopic dermatitis/eczema prevention) is Skin, which is out of scope - do not build GI or Immune claims from that literature. A cow milk allergy oral-tolerance SR also turned up with no matching outcome_areas id; worth a proposed_impacts entry from the Immune pass if the finding holds up, after checking excluded_outcomes first.
